name: section-gallery
title: Gallery Section
description: A gallery of images in two layouts (grid, wall) whose thumbnails open a keyboard-complete lightbox and still open each image without JavaScript, that takes its colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Grid
layouts.description: Square tiles in two columns, three from md and four from lg, each image cut to its square; the default.

layouts.title: Wall
layouts.description: Flowing columns, two and three from md, each image at its own ratio, no row alignment.
layouts.usage: <GallerySection layout="wall" content={{ title, images: [{ src, alt, width, height, caption, full }] }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (grid, wall); a lightbox by keyboard; thumbnails open their image without JS; 3 sample brands, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px in two hosts; axe clean; no leak
postMessage: See components/section-gallery/README.md for the layouts, the lightbox, the labels (German included), the design tokens it reads and how to pass a next/image wrapper.
